title: Equal remainders of sum and distance
prompt:
Specification: count_pairs(xs) returns the number of unordered pairs of distinct elements i < j such that (xs[i] + xs[j]) % 9 == (j - i) % 9.

Does the implementation below comply with the specification?

evidence.title: Specification case: [9, 1]
evidence.body:
Expected: 1 (the pair (9, 1): sum 10, distance 1; both have remainder 1)
Actual: 1

recommendation.text: The implementation is NOT_COMPLIANT. The function excludes pairs with i = j, but the specification allows an element to be paired with itself.
